web_fixture.content:
# Error reference

copperlane pipeline errors print as CL-NNNN. Each entry gives the condition name used across our dashboards and the action the runbook expects.

| Code | Condition | Meaning and action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CL-5404 | latefeed | The settlement feed arrived past the cutoff. Re-run the window once the feed lands. |
| CL-5812 | ledgerdrift | The posted ledger entries no longer reconcile against the settlement file: one side was altered after the batch was sealed. Freeze the batch and re-reconcile before retrying. |
| CL-5901 | gatehold | The batch is held behind a manual review flag. Clear the flag or escalate. |
| CL-5230 | thincover | Too few confirmations arrived to seal the batch. Wait for confirmations or lower the quorum. |

Last reviewed 2026-07-08.

web_fixture.content:
# Settlement delay, 14 May 2026 (resolved)

From 09:12 to 09:56 UTC, settlement windows on the EU cluster ran late because the upstream feed was slow. Batches were retried automatically and no entries were lost.

The incident did not introduce any new error code. The retries were recorded against the existing pipeline codes, and the reference page describes each of those.

Resolved 2026-05-14.
